recipes.d: Tender beef and mushrooms in rich gravy
steps: Brown the diced beef in batches in a casserole pan.
Soften chopped onion, carrots and mushrooms, then stir in tomato purée.
Return beef to pan with stock and simmer gently with a lid for around 75 minutes or until tender.
Boil potatoes, mash and serve with the piping-hot casserole.

recipes.d: Chicken and peppers under golden pastry
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cook diced chicken thoroughly.
Add sliced leeks and peppers until soft; melt in butter, stir in flour and gradually add milk to make a thick filling.
Put filling in a baking dish and cover with pastry, cutting a steam hole in the centre.
Bake until the pastry is fully cooked and centre of the pie piping hot.

recipes.d: A large pan of mild chicken and bean chilli
steps: Cook rice following the packet directions.
Soften chopped onion and peppers in a large saucepan.
Add chicken mince and cook completely, then stir in paprika, drained beans and passata.
Simmer until thick and piping hot; serve with rice.

recipes.d: Vegetable lasagne with creamy white sauce
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and roast diced aubergine, courgette and peppers until soft.
Melt butter, stir in flour and gradually whisk in milk to make white sauce.
Layer passata, vegetables, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a baking dish and finish with cheese.
Bake until the sheets are tender and the top golden and bubbling.

recipes.d: Chicken, carrots and peas in creamy sauce
steps: Boil diced potatoes until soft while preparing the casserole.
Brown chicken thighs in a deep pan and add chopped leeks and carrots.
Pour in stock and simmer until vegetables are tender and chicken thoroughly cooked.
Stir in peas and crème fraîche, heat until piping hot and serve with potatoes.

recipes.d: Beef mince beneath sweet potato mash
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); boil peeled sweet potatoes until soft and mash.
Brown mince completely with onions, then add grated carrot and tomato purée.
Add stock and peas and simmer until thickened and thoroughly hot.
Transfer to a baking dish, spread mash on top and bake until bubbling and browned.

recipes.d: Roasted sausages with squash and onion
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan), peel and dice butternut.
Slice onions and peppers and toss with squash, rosemary and oil in a roasting tray.
Place sausages on top, add a splash of prepared stock and roast, turning once.
Serve when squash is soft and sausages cooked completely through.

recipes.d: Cheesy baked chicken and broccoli noodles
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); cook noodles and broccoli until just tender.
Dice chicken and cook thoroughly in a pan.
Make sauce by melting butter, stirring in flour, then gradually whisking in milk.
Combine chicken, noodles, broccoli and sauce, add cheese and bake until golden and piping hot.

recipes.d: Hearty sausage and white bean stew
steps: Brown sausages until cooked through, then remove and slice.
Soften diced onion and carrots in the same pan.
Add tomatoes, drained beans and thyme and simmer until carrots are tender.
Return sausage pieces and heat everything until piping hot.

recipes.d: Paprika beef pasta with kidney beans
steps: Boil penne according to the packet.
Cook chopped onion and beef mince until beef is thoroughly cooked.
Stir through paprika, drained beans and passata and simmer until thick.
Toss hot pasta through the sauce and serve.

recipes.d: Pork chops roasted with apples and roots
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); roast evenly cut parsnips and carrots with a little oil for 15 minutes.
Add apple and onion wedges to the tray.
Nestle pork chops among the vegetables with thyme and roast, turning as needed.
Serve once pork is thoroughly cooked and vegetables tender.

recipes.d: Baked white fish and potato slices
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); thinly slice and parboil potatoes.
Soften leeks in butter, stir in flour and gradually whisk in milk to make sauce.
Layer potatoes, fish and sauce in a dish, finishing with lemon and cheese.
Bake until potatoes are soft, fish fully cooked and top bubbling.

recipes.d: Creamy chicken, potato and sweetcorn soup
steps: Dice chicken and potatoes, slice leeks and onion.
Soften onion and leeks, then add chicken and cook until browned and no pink remains.
Add potatoes and stock and simmer until potatoes tender and chicken thoroughly cooked.
Add milk and sweetcorn, heat gently and serve piping hot.

recipes.d: Lentil lasagne with sweet roasted peppers
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and roast sliced peppers until tender.
Combine cooked drained lentils with passata and roasted peppers.
Whisk white sauce from butter, flour and milk; layer with lentil sauce and lasagne in a dish.
Finish with cheese and bake until pasta sheets are tender and top golden.

recipes.d: Cheesy oven rice with beef and broccoli
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cook rice following packet directions.
Cut broccoli into small florets and steam until just tender.
Brown beef completely with onion, then mix with passata, cooked rice and broccoli.
Transfer to a baking dish, add cheese and bake until bubbling and hot throughout.

recipes.d: Golden chickpea and spinach pastry pie
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and soften chopped onion.
Add drained chickpeas, passata and cumin; simmer until thick and stir in spinach.
Transfer to a pie dish, cool slightly, cover with pastry and brush with beaten egg.
Bake until pastry golden and cooked through and filling thoroughly hot.

recipes.d: Cheesy family pasta bake with chicken and leeks
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); boil pasta until just tender.
Dice chicken and cook until thoroughly done, adding washed leeks until soft.
Stir through cream cheese and milk and combine with pasta in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake until golden and piping hot.

recipes.d: Herby chicken and vegetables roasted together
steps: Heat oven to 210°C (190°C fan), dice potatoes and carrots and slice onion.
Coat vegetables and chicken with pesto in a large roasting tray.
Roast, turning once, until vegetables are tender and chicken thoroughly cooked.
Serve hot with tray juices.

recipes.d: Baked cod with peppers, tomatoes and courgette
steps: Heat oven to 210°C (190°C fan), chop courgettes and peppers into even chunks.
Toss vegetables and tomatoes with olive oil and roast until starting to soften.
Lay cod on top and squeeze over lemon; return to oven until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Check fish is fully cooked and serve with roasted vegetables.

recipes.d: Lentils and root vegetables beneath mash
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); boil potatoes until tender and mash.
Dice carrots, parsnips and onion and soften in a large pan.
Add drained cooked lentils and stock and simmer until vegetables tender and mixture thick.
Spoon into a dish, top with mash and bake until hot and golden.
